column3: [annoyed] A sleeping pill? Today? I never said we're going to sleep.
You just swallowed a sleeping pill.
[exhausted, pleading] I can't take it anymore. I've been fighting anxiety for days. I can't sleep at all. Please, break it down faster.
[grumbling] Fine. But you owe me one.
[firm] Everyone, calm down! We're not dying. Nothing is wrong!
[frustrated] Why do you never listen? I'm so tired of this job.
[beaten, sulky] They never listen. I quit.
[curious] Hey, what's going on in here?
[grumpy] Why do you care? If you came to gossip, do it outside.
[friendly] No gossip. We're sleeping pills. We're here to calm things down, so the owner can finally get some real rest.
[perking up] Oh, in that case, let's go.
[calm, firm] Okay, everyone. Quiet down. Settle down. Yep, just like that.
[warm] Honey, after that sleeping pill last night, you finally slept better than you have in weeks.
